variants.headline: Party divides in two
variants.sub: A split in {party} has produced the new party {splinter}.
variants.body:
The party {party} has split, with {splinter} the new breakaway party. The division is an organisational fact, not a complete explanation of the differences behind it. In considering {target}, readers should distinguish the break itself from unreported motives, ideological labels or claims about the balance of parliamentary strength.

The gazette records the division of the party without ascribing a particular doctrine or dispute to either part. Organisational separation is distinct from a transfer of public office or a change of government. The report should therefore remain precise about the development that has actually been established.

The responsibility of {target} should be considered without presuming the split's cause or its eventual consequences. This account records an organisational division and reserves judgment on particulars not supplied. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.
